# Placement fixtures

Real inputs for `/api/sponsor/place` (`src/services/placement.test.ts`,
`src/utils/episodePlacement.test.ts`, `src/services/anime/animeSynonyms.test.ts`).
Nothing here is hand-written; fields placement does not read are left out of recorded
answers, and every value kept is as received.

| `releases.json`                        | 38 releases of the rex library on fun (2026-10-16: the row's `_release`, `_folder`, file name and the IMDb id zurg pushed), and rex's `tests/fixtures/anime/releases.json` and `batch_files.json` with the show's IMDb id; and releases zurg on fun asked DMM to place (2026-10-17: the `.zurgtorrent`'s name, files, folders and IMDb id), a few sent again without the id, as zurg will, and one it holds without an id; and two Crunchyroll-numbered One Piece episodes zurg-usenet on fun asked about on 2026-10-18 (`One.Piece.1999.S23E22`/`S23E25`), which TMDB's TVDB Order group makes S23E1177/S23E1180 (Sonarr's TVDB numbering has S23E21 as absolute 1176) | Each case's `expect` is DMM's answer, checked against rex's placement (`rex`). Where they differ, TMDB's own season list decides: One Piece `- 0423` is TMDB's S13E423 (rex: S1E423, which TMDB does not list), Medabots' `06 - The Gimme Ghost` is TMDB's S1E7 "The Gimme Ghost", Ace of Diamond Act II S2 is TMDB's season 4. Thousand-Year Blood War is TMDB's Bleach season 2 (rex: `Bleach: Sennen Kessen-hen`, 336301), and `BLEACH.Thousand-Year.Blood.War.S04E01` its S2E41 "GOD OF THUNDER", the Calamity's first (rex: S4E1). `Kashin Tan - E08`, which zurg sent with the Calamity's film id, is S2E48 "THE END TWO WORLD" (rex: the film). `[KH] Motto To Love-Ru` is To Love Ru (34742) season 2, its episodes titled as TMDB titles S2E1-E12; its `Extras` are no episodes (rex placed `Menu - 02` as S1E2). Aim to be a Pokémon Master is TMDB's Pokémon S25E47-E57, which nothing DMM reads maps, so it stays unplaced (rex: S1E10). `Détective Conan S11E01 - 286` stays unplaced: IMDb's S11E01 is TMDB's S1E271, while French Wikipedia's episode 286 is Japanese 479, a 90-minute special, and these files run 24 minutes (rex: S11E1 of `Shinichi Kudo's Written Challenge`, 85462). `Kingdom.S02E06.1080p.NF.WEB-DL…-ExREN`, which the identifier does not name, is Netflix's Korean Kingdom (rex: TMDB 70593 S2E6) and no anime, so DMM leaves it unplaced. |
| `answers.json`                         | Every provider answer those releases needed: TMDB's find, show details and season lists through DMM's `/api/metadata` (`?sources=tmdb`), `imdb_title_episode` and `Anime` rows from dmmdb, the Fribb dataset (2026-10-16), manami's anime-offline-database (release 2026-27); for the 2026-10-17 releases the same sources that day (the Fribb dataset of 2026-10-17), and TMDB's own answer where the metadata API answered 404; and TMDB's own `tv/37854/episode_groups` and its TVDB Order group `62f98314175051007c594bdf` (2026-10-18, as `episodeGroups` and `episodeGroup`, which the metadata API does not serve), kept to the fields placement reads           | The Fribb entries are those of every show placement looked at and every title it looked up, with all their names, so the index answers each lookup as the full one does. `identify` holds DMM's `/api/sponsor/identify` answers for the names that needed one. Where the metadata API answered 404 its find knew nothing; TMDB's own `/find/tt10710138` (the id zurg pushed for `[iKaos] TFS Dragon Ball Z Abridged Collection`) answered empty lists, recorded as such. Info hashes are left out: placement does not read them. TMDB answers show 335660, which DMM's cached find for tt14986406 still names, with a 404 (`status_code` 34): it has deleted the show. Shows recorded on 2026-10-17 keep `original_language`: placement reads it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
